steps.title: Lower half
steps.text: Slide the lower clamp half under the two lever struts so the struts sit in its slots.

steps.title: Upper half
steps.text: Lower the upper half onto the struts until the two halves meet at the parting plane.

steps.title: Clamp bolts
steps.text: Drop both M6 bolts through the holes in the V gap. Nuts and washers are not modelled in this prototype.
